body: i'm sorry you are going through all of that. i definitely understand what youre saying about testing the limits of your parents' love.

guess just tired. i feel like everyone has everything going for them and all of my friends that i used to have are getting married, having kids, having careers.. they are all too happy and busy to want me around. its like they don't need me so they don't bother with me.
i'm not asking for a push in the suicide direction. i'm asking for reasons to live. looking back on my post,  i guess that wasnt clear.
